model.src:
; The Shell from the sketch: 23 blocks in 4 levels.
(block Shell
  :type "Module"
  (sketch "The UI shell user interacts via.")
  (message Intent (sketch "A command id plus its arguments."))
  (message Frame (sketch "A rendered view-model for one surface."))
  (message SessionEvent (sketch "A turn was added, edited or removed."))
  (message Notice (sketch "A short message for the user, with a severity."))
  (message KeyChord (sketch "A normalized key combination."))
  (behavior Surface
    (port frame in Frame)
    (port intent out Intent)
    (sketch "A behavior shared by surfaces."))
  (behavior Durable
    (port event in SessionEvent)
    (sketch "Retains every accepted event until it is acknowledged."))

  (level
    (adjacent
      (block Shell.Notification
        :type "Process"
        (implements Surface)
        (port notice in Notice)
        (sketch "Shows transient notices above the session.")
        (level
          (adjacent
            (block Shell.Toast (sketch "One notice with an auto-dismiss timer."))
            (block Shell.Banner (sketch "A persistent notice pinned to the top."))))
        (level
          (block Shell.NoticeQueue
            (implements Durable)
            (sketch "Orders notices by severity, then arrival."))))
      (block Shell.SessionView
        :type "Process"
        (implements Surface)
        (port events in SessionEvent)
        (sketch "View of the Session")
        (message TurnAdded (refines SessionEvent) (sketch "Also carries the new turn's id and author."))
        (behavior Scrollable
          (port position out Frame)
          (sketch "Keeps a scroll position and reports what is visible."))
        (level
          (adjacent
            (block Shell.Transcript
              (implements Scrollable)
              (sketch "Scrollable list of turns.")
              (level
                (block Shell.TurnList (sketch "Virtualized list; only visible turns mount.")))
              (level
                (adjacent
                  (block Shell.Turn
                    (port added in TurnAdded)
                    (sketch "One user or agent turn.")
                    (level
                      (adjacent
                        (block Shell.Markdown (sketch "Renders prose with inline code."))
                        (block Shell.CodeBlock (sketch "Highlighted code with a copy action."))
                        (block Shell.ToolCall (sketch "Collapsible tool invocation and its result.")))))
                  (block Shell.TurnActions (sketch "Copy, retry and edit controls.")))))
            (block Shell.Composer
              (port submit out Intent)
              (sketch "Multiline input with attachments and slash commands."))))
        (level
          (block Shell.ScrollAnchor
            (sketch "Keeps the reading position when content above grows."))))
      (block Shell.Sidebar
        (implements Surface)
        (sketch "Recent sessions and the project switcher.")))
    (block Shell.CommandPalette
      (port chord in KeyChord)
      (port run out Intent)
      (sketch "Fuzzy search over every command.")))

  (level
    (block Shell.Theme (sketch "Resolves design tokens for light and dark."))
    (adjacent
      (block Shell.Router
        (port intent in Intent)
        (sketch "Maps intents to handlers; unknown intents become notices."))
      (block Shell.Keymap
        (port chord out KeyChord)
        (sketch "Turns raw key events into chords."))
      (block Shell.Clipboard (sketch "Copy and paste with rich formats."))))

  (level
    (block Shell.LowLevelThing (sketch "Low level module thing."))
    (block Shell.SurfaceKit
      (implements Surface)
      (sketch "Primitives every surface is drawn with."))
    (block Shell.SessionStore
      :type "Store"
      (implements Durable)
      (port events out SessionEvent)
      (sketch "Keeps session events on disk and replays them on launch."))))
